```{r}
# READ IN FILES ----------------------------------------------------------------

# Import codon usage scores for each gene
usage_long <- read.csv(file.path(input_dir,"Codon_Usage_AllGenes.csv"))

tsl_results <- read.csv(file.path(tsl_dir, "P0_All_dTE_Results.csv"))
rna_results <- read.csv(file.path(rna_dir, "P0_All_dRNA_Results.csv"))

# ID up, down, and no change genes  --------------------------------------------

gen_gene_lists <- function(results) {
  up <- filter(results, padj<0.1 & log2FoldChange>0)
  down <- filter(results, padj<0.1 & log2FoldChange<0)
  no_change <- filter(results, padj>=0.1)
  
  return(list(up=up$X,
              down=down$X,
              no_change=no_change$X)) 
}

tsl_lists <- gen_gene_lists(tsl_results)
rna_lists <- gen_gene_lists(rna_results)


# LABEL genes by status, extract codon usage info ------------------------------

filter_genes <- function(data,
                         genes) {
  
  filtered <- data %>%
    filter(gene %in% c(genes$up, genes$down, genes$no_change)) %>%
    mutate(Set=case_when(
      gene %in% genes$up ~ "Up",
      gene %in% genes$down ~ "Down",
      TRUE ~ "NoChange"
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("Down","NoChange","Up"))) 
  
  frequency <- filtered  %>%
    dplyr::select(gene, codon, freq) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = codon, values_from = freq, values_fill = 0) %>%
    column_to_rownames("gene")
  
  annotations <- data.frame(Set = filtered %>% distinct(gene, Set) %>% pull(Set))
  rownames(annotations) <- rownames(frequency)
  
  GC_content <- filtered  %>%
    dplyr::select(gene, GC_fraction, Set)
  GC_content$Set <- factor(GC_content$Set, levels = c("Down","NoChange","Up"))
  
  return(list(results = frequency,
              sets = annotations,
              GC = GC_content))
  
}

tsl_codon_results <- filter_genes(usage_long,
                                  tsl_lists)

rna_codon_results <- filter_genes(usage_long,
                                  rna_lists)
```

# ID significant codons --------------------------------------------------------
```{r}


sig_codons <- function(data){
  freq_long <- data$results %>%
    rownames_to_column(var="gene") %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = -gene,
                 names_to = "codon",
                 values_to = "frequency")
  
  annot <- data$sets %>%
    rownames_to_column(var="gene")
  
  freq_annot <- freq_long %>%
    left_join(
      annot, by="gene"
    )
  
  freq_results <- freq_annot %>%
    group_by(codon,Set) %>%
    summarise(
      mean_freq = mean(frequency, na.rm=TRUE),
      se_freq = sd(frequency, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
      n = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  codon_stats <- freq_annot %>%
    group_by(codon) %>%
    summarise(
      p_value = kruskal.test(frequency ~ Set)$p.value,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  codon_stats <- codon_stats %>%
    mutate(padj = p.adjust(p_value, method = "fdr"))
  
  freq_results <- left_join(freq_results, codon_stats, by = "codon")
  
  freq_results <- freq_results %>%
    mutate(
      GC_percent = str_count(codon, "[GCgc]") / 3 * 100
    )
  
  df_wide <- freq_results %>%
    dplyr::select(codon, Set, mean_freq, se_freq) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from  = Set,
      values_from = c(mean_freq, se_freq)
    ) 
  
  df_wide <- df_wide %>%
    dplyr::rename(
      up_mean       = mean_freq_Up,
      down_mean     = mean_freq_Down,
      nochange_mean = mean_freq_NoChange,
      up_se         = se_freq_Up,
      down_se       = se_freq_Down,
      nochange_se   = se_freq_NoChange
    )
  
  # 2. make a codon→GC lookup (one row per codon)
  gc_lookup <- freq_results %>%
    dplyr::select(codon, GC_percent) %>%
    distinct()
  
  pvalue_lookup <- freq_results %>%
    dplyr::select(codon,padj) %>%
    distinct()
  
  # 3. join it on
  df_wide2 <- df_wide %>%
    left_join(gc_lookup, by = "codon")
  
  df_wide3 <- df_wide2 %>%
    left_join(pvalue_lookup, by = "codon")
  
  return(list(res_long=freq_results,
              res_wide=df_wide3))
  
}


tsl_sig_codons <- sig_codons(tsl_codon_results) 
rna_sig_codons <- sig_codons(rna_codon_results) 

write.csv(tsl_sig_codons$res_long,file.path(output_dir,"TSL_SigCodons_Long.csv"))
write.csv(tsl_sig_codons$res_wide,file.path(output_dir,"TSL_SigCodons_Wide.csv"))
write.csv(rna_sig_codons$res_long,file.path(output_dir,"RNA_SigCodons_Long.csv"))
write.csv(rna_sig_codons$res_wide,file.path(output_dir,"RNA_SigCodons_Wide.csv"))
```

```{r}
rna_scatter <- ggplot(rna_sig_codons$res_wide,
```

```{r}
###### INDIVIDUAL CODON VIOLIN PLOTS #########

plot_significant_codon_violins <- function(freq_long, sig_codons, out_dir, prefix="") {
  # Get only codons with padj < 0.1
  sig_codon_list <- sig_codons$res_wide %>%
    filter(padj < 0.1) %>%
    pull(codon)
  
  # Loop through each significant codon and plot
  for (codon in sig_codon_list) {
    dat <- freq_long %>% filter(codon == !!codon)
    if(nrow(dat) == 0) next
    
    plt <- ggplot(dat, aes(x=Set, y=frequency, fill=Set)) +
      geom_violin(trim=FALSE, alpha=0.7) +
      geom_boxplot(width=0.1, outlier.shape=NA, fill="white") +
      labs(title = paste("Codon:", codon),
           x = "Gene Category",
           y = "Codon Frequency") +
      my_theme
    
    # Output filename
    fname <- file.path(out_dir, paste0(prefix, "CodonFreq_Violin_", codon, ".pdf"))
    ggsave(filename = fname, plot = plt, width = 2, height = 2, units = "in")
  }
}

tsl_freq_long <- tsl_codon_results$results %>%
  rownames_to_column(var="gene") %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -gene, names_to = "codon", values_to = "frequency") %>%
  left_join(tsl_codon_results$sets %>% rownames_to_column(var="gene"), by = "gene")

plot_significant_codon_violins(tsl_freq_long, tsl_sig_codons, output_dir, prefix="TSL_")
```
